messages:
Ava: ok team, emergency cuteness drop. meet Guac, my hamster. I made him a tiny avocado pit bed 🥑🛌 pics attached
Ravi: omg that is peak tiny pet furniture :joy: can't handle it
Leo: how is the pit glued together? is Guac allowed to gnaw on it? 😅
Ava: no glue! cedar bowl + cut foam + fabric wrap. non-toxic. quick sketch:
```
sew circle -> insert foam -> hollow pit -> place
```
Sofia: name is perfect. chef ham :chef_kiss:
Ravi: vote: tiny pet furniture contest at next office picnic? :raised_hands:
Ava: i'm in. i'll try 3 prototypes. maybe a cactus one?
Leo: will accept prototypes in exchange for guac crumb bribes
ops-bot: :thumbsup: pinned to #random by ops-bot
